weekly_archive.title: Fed rate hike is about Wall Street, not inflation, says economist
weekly_archive.description: Goldman Sachs late Friday became the last of the major banks to retract its forecast of no rate hike next week.
weekly_archive.summary: A Fed rate hike next week is now expected after Goldman Sachs reversed its no-hike forecast, increasing pressure on risk assets such as crypto. The economist cited says the move is aimed at Wall Street rather than inflation.

weekly_archive.title: Crypto's Clarity Act is a Schrödinger's cat in life-death limbo as U.S. Senate returns
weekly_archive.description: The crypto industry eagerly awaits a September 15 vote, though it might not happen. Or maybe it will. Or it might get delayed or reappear in some other form.
weekly_archive.summary: US Senate crypto market structure bill faces uncertain Sept. 15 vote, keeping major regulatory clarity in limbo for traders. The measure could pass, be delayed, or return in another form, leaving industry participants waiting on rules that could affect exchanges, tokens, and institutional adoption.

weekly_archive.title: Quantum-proof blockchain: why math, not machines, holds the key
weekly_archive.description: lockchains don’t need quantum computers to be quantum-safe, argues Optimum co-founder and MIT professor Muriel Médard. Classic math already gives us the tools.
weekly_archive.summary: A leading MIT professor argues blockchains can achieve quantum safety using existing mathematical tools, not future quantum computers. The approach relies on hash-based signatures, which are already considered resistant to quantum attacks.
